blocks.label: Start
blocks.description: Start here when you press Run, with some starting values (also defaults for Run Workflow).

blocks.label: Timer
blocks.description: Start the flow on a schedule, or delay it when placed after another block.

fields.label: Seconds
fields.help: Under 30 seconds the extension keeps its background worker awake to fire on time (Chromium). 30 seconds or more uses browser alarms. After another block: waits up to 600 s inside the run; longer delays continue as a new run.

fields.label: Repeat
fields.help: Only used when this block starts the flow. After another block it always fires once.

outputs.description: How many times the timer has fired (when it starts the flow).

blocks.label: Schedule
blocks.description: Start the flow at set times: daily at 09:00, on weekdays, every hour, every N minutes.

fields.label: At (HH:MM)
fields.help: For "day". Local time of this computer.

fields.label: Days
fields.help: For "day": every day, weekdays, weekends, or names: mon, wed, fri.

fields.label: Minute
fields.help: For "hour": minutes past the hour.

fields.label: Minutes
fields.help: For "N minutes". Runs on the clock (:00, :15, :30…).

outputs.description: The time it was planned for.

blocks.label: Page Visited
blocks.description: Start when you open a matching page (in any tab). That tab becomes "main".

fields.label: Page URL pattern
fields.help: Plain text = the URL contains it; * any part between slashes; ** anything; /…/ regex.

blocks.label: Context Menu
blocks.description: Add an item to the right-click menu that starts the flow on that page.

blocks.label: Watch Element
blocks.description: Fire when the text of a part of a web page changes.

fields.label: Check every (seconds)
fields.help: Only used when this block starts the flow. After a Timer, the Timer decides. Under 30 seconds keeps the background worker awake.

fields.label: Reload page before checking
fields.help: Needed to see server-side changes. Turn off for pages that update themselves.

fields.label: Fire on the first read too
fields.help: Off = the first read just records the starting value.

outputs.description: The new text of the element.
The text before the change (null on the first read).
The element locator (also as `selector`, its name before v0.3).
ISO time the change was noticed.

blocks.label: Open Tab
blocks.description: Open a web page, and remember the tab for the next blocks.

fields.label: URL
fields.help: Use {{name}} to insert a value from the previous block.

fields.label: Tab name
fields.help: Later blocks find the tab by this name. Use another name (e.g. "admin") for a second tab.

fields.label: Switch to it
fields.help: Off = open quietly in the background.

outputs.description: Id of the tab it was opened in.

blocks.label: Navigate
blocks.description: Go to a URL, back, forward, or reload, in a tab of this run.

fields.label: Tab
fields.help: The name an Open Tab block gave the tab earlier in this run. Usually "main".

blocks.label: Wait for Popup
blocks.description: Catch a new tab or window the page opened, and name it for the next blocks.

fields.label: Opened by tab
fields.help: The name an Open Tab block gave the tab earlier in this run. Usually "main".

outputs.description: The address of the new tab.

blocks.label: Close Tab
blocks.description: Close a tab this run opened.

fields.label: Tab
fields.help: The name an Open Tab block gave the tab earlier in this run. Usually "main".

blocks.label: Click
blocks.description: Click (or double-click, right-click, hover) an element. Waits until it can be clicked.

fields.label: Element
fields.help: CSS, or text=…, role=…[name="…"], label=…, placeholder=…, testid=…, A >> B, >> nth=0. Or press 🎯 Pick.

fields.label: Skip the checks
fields.help: Click even if the element looks hidden, disabled or covered. Only for stubborn pages.

fields.label: Tab
fields.help: The name an Open Tab block gave the tab earlier in this run. Usually "main".

blocks.label: Fill
blocks.description: Type a value into a text field. Works with React, Vue and Angular forms.

fields.label: Field
fields.help: CSS, or text=…, role=…[name="…"], label=…, placeholder=…, testid=…, A >> B, >> nth=0. Or press 🎯 Pick.

fields.label: Tab
fields.help: The name an Open Tab block gave the tab earlier in this run. Usually "main".

blocks.label: Fill Form
blocks.description: Fill several fields at once: text, selects, checkboxes. Optionally click submit.

fields.label: Fields
fields.help: Empty values are skipped. Selects take the option text or value; checkboxes take true or false.

fields.label: Then click (optional)
fields.help: CSS, or text=…, role=…[name="…"], label=…, placeholder=…, testid=…, A >> B, >> nth=0. Or press 🎯 Pick.

fields.label: Tab
fields.help: The name an Open Tab block gave the tab earlier in this run. Usually "main".

blocks.label: Select Option
blocks.description: Choose an option in a dropdown (<select>), by its text or value.

fields.label: Dropdown
fields.help: CSS, or text=…, role=…[name="…"], label=…, placeholder=…, testid=…, A >> B, >> nth=0. Or press 🎯 Pick.

fields.label: Option
fields.help: Several for a multi-select: separate with |

fields.label: Tab
fields.help: The name an Open Tab block gave the tab earlier in this run. Usually "main".

blocks.label: Check
blocks.description: Tick or untick a checkbox, radio button or switch. Does nothing if it already is.

fields.label: Checkbox
fields.help: CSS, or text=…, role=…[name="…"], label=…, placeholder=…, testid=…, A >> B, >> nth=0. Or press 🎯 Pick.

fields.label: Tab
fields.help: The name an Open Tab block gave the tab earlier in this run. Usually "main".

blocks.label: Press Key
blocks.description: Press a key or shortcut (Enter, Tab, Escape, Control+A…), or insert text at the caret.

fields.label: Key
fields.help: Key names as on the keyboard: Enter, Tab, Escape, Backspace, ArrowDown, a, Control+A, Shift+Tab, Control+Shift+K. ControlOrMeta+A is ⌘A on a Mac, Ctrl+A elsewhere.

fields.label: Text
fields.help: For "insert text": typed at the caret in one go, like pasting.

fields.label: On element (optional)
fields.help: Focus this element first. Empty = whatever has focus.

fields.label: Tab
fields.help: The name an Open Tab block gave the tab earlier in this run. Usually "main".

blocks.label: Upload File
blocks.description: Choose a file for a file input, without the file dialog: text you write, or a file from a URL.

fields.label: File input
fields.help: The <input type="file"> (hidden ones work too), or its label.

fields.label: Content
fields.help: For "text".

fields.label: URL
fields.help: For "download".

fields.label: File name
fields.help: Empty with a URL = the name in the URL.

fields.label: Type
fields.help: For "text". With a URL the server says.

fields.label: Tab
fields.help: The name an Open Tab block gave the tab earlier in this run. Usually "main".

blocks.label: Scroll
blocks.description: Scroll to the bottom, top or an element; or keep scrolling until no more content loads.

fields.label: Element
fields.help: Only for "to an element".

fields.label: Tab
fields.help: The name an Open Tab block gave the tab earlier in this run. Usually "main".

blocks.label: Dialogs
blocks.description: Answer alert / confirm / prompt boxes automatically, or read what they said.

fields.label: Tab
fields.help: The name an Open Tab block gave the tab earlier in this run. Usually "main".

outputs.description: Dialogs shown in this page so far: {type, message}.
The message of the latest one.

blocks.label: Wait For
blocks.description: Wait until an element appears or goes, some text shows, the URL changes, or the page settles.

fields.label: Element
fields.help: For the element modes. For text: only look inside this element (optional).

fields.label: URL pattern
fields.help: Plain text: the URL contains it. * matches any part between slashes, ** anything. /…/ is a regular expression. Also the request address for "a network request finishes".

fields.label: Status (optional)
fields.help: For "a network request finishes".

fields.label: Tab
fields.help: The name an Open Tab block gave the tab earlier in this run. Usually "main".

outputs.description: The tab's URL when the wait ended.
For "a network request finishes": {url, status, method}.

blocks.label: Run Script
blocks.description: Run your own JavaScript in the page; its return value is saved. Chrome 135+.

fields.label: JavaScript
fields.help: An async function body: use await, read `data`, and `return` a JSON value.

fields.label: Tab
fields.help: The name an Open Tab block gave the tab earlier in this run. Usually "main".

outputs.description: What the code returned (or the name you chose).

blocks.label: Read Element
blocks.description: Read a value from a page: text, attribute, class, whether it exists, or how many.

fields.label: Page URL
fields.help: BlockFlow opens it in its own background tab. Leave empty to read the run's tab instead (see Tab).

fields.label: Tab
fields.help: Used when Page URL is empty: read from this tab of the run (from Open Tab), as it is now, without reloading.

fields.label: Attribute / class name
fields.help: Only for "an attribute" and "has a class".

outputs.description: What was read ("true"/"false" for class and exists).
The value from the last run (empty on the first run).
True when value differs from previous (false on the first run).
How many elements matched the locator.
The locator that was read (also as `selector`, its name before v0.3).

blocks.label: Extract List
blocks.description: Scrape repeated items (cards, results, rows) into a list of objects.

fields.label: Each item
fields.help: CSS, or text=…, role=…[name="…"], label=…, placeholder=…, testid=…, A >> B, >> nth=0. Or press 🎯 Pick.

fields.label: Fields
fields.help: No fields = each item's text as {text}. Links (href, src) come back as full URLs.

fields.label: HTML
fields.help: Only for "HTML in the data".

fields.label: Page address
fields.help: Makes relative links absolute (HTML mode).

fields.label: Tab
fields.help: The name an Open Tab block gave the tab earlier in this run. Usually "main".

outputs.description: The list (or the name you chose).

blocks.label: Extract Table
blocks.description: Read an HTML table into a list of rows, keyed by its column headers.

fields.label: Table
fields.help: CSS, or text=…, role=…[name="…"], label=…, placeholder=…, testid=…, A >> B, >> nth=0. Or press 🎯 Pick.

fields.label: HTML
fields.help: Only for "HTML in the data".

fields.label: Page address
fields.help: Makes relative links absolute (HTML mode).

fields.label: Tab
fields.help: The name an Open Tab block gave the tab earlier in this run. Usually "main".

outputs.description: One object per row (or the name you chose).

blocks.label: Paginate
blocks.description: Run "each" on every page of a paged list, clicking Next in between.

fields.label: Next button
fields.help: CSS, or text=…, role=…[name="…"], label=…, placeholder=…, testid=…, A >> B, >> nth=0. Or press 🎯 Pick.

fields.label: Tab
fields.help: The name an Open Tab block gave the tab earlier in this run. Usually "main".

outputs.description: On "done": how many pages were visited.

blocks.label: Page Info
blocks.description: Read the page itself: title, meta tags, JSON-LD, or its localStorage / cookies.

fields.label: Key (optional)
fields.help: Storage and cookies: one key. Empty = all of them.

fields.label: Tab
fields.help: The name an Open Tab block gave the tab earlier in this run. Usually "main".

outputs.description: For "page": url, title, description, canonical, lang, meta, jsonLd, links.
For storage and cookies: the value (or an object of all of them).

blocks.label: Page Snapshot
blocks.description: Outline of what is on the page (roles, names, a locator for each element), to write steps from or keep with the run.

fields.label: Part of the page (optional)
fields.help: Only this element and what is inside it. Empty = the whole page.

fields.label: At most (lines)
fields.help: Long pages are cut here, with a note.

fields.label: Tab
fields.help: The name an Open Tab block gave the tab earlier in this run. Usually "main".

outputs.description: The outline: one element per line, e.g. - button "Sign in" [ref=e3] locator=role=button[name="Sign in"].
The same elements as a list of {ref, role, name, tag, locator, value?, checked?, disabled?, level?, url?}.

blocks.label: Assert
blocks.description: Check that something is true. Fails the run (or just records it, if soft) when it is not.

fields.label: Element
fields.help: For element checks.

fields.label: Attribute or CSS property
fields.help: The attribute name for "attribute of an element", the CSS property (color, display…) for "CSS value".

fields.label: Value
fields.help: Only for "a value from the data".

fields.label: Must
fields.help: Not used by the yes/no checks (visible, checked…).

fields.label: Soft: record the failure but keep going
Tab
fields.help: The name an Open Tab block gave the tab earlier in this run. Usually "main".

blocks.label: Manual Step
blocks.description: Pause until you press Continue: solve a CAPTCHA, type a 2FA code, take a look.

defaultConfig.message: Solve the CAPTCHA in the open tab, then press Continue.

outputs.description: The input, passed on after you continue.

blocks.label: Stop
blocks.description: End this path here: as passed, or as failed with a message.

blocks.label: If
blocks.description: Go one way when a condition is true, another when it is false.

fields.label: Compare to
fields.help: Ignored by "is empty", "is true" and similar. For a pattern, write /text/i.

outputs.description: The input, unchanged, out of "true" or "false".

blocks.label: For Each
blocks.description: Repeat the blocks on "each" for every item of a list, then continue from "done".

fields.label: List
fields.help: Where the list is in the data, e.g. items or data.results (an expression, no {{ }}).

outputs.description: On "each": the current item (or the name you chose).
On "each": how many items there are.
On "done": how many items were processed.

blocks.label: Repeat
blocks.description: Run the blocks on "each" a number of times, then continue from "done".

blocks.label: Run Workflow
blocks.description: Run another workflow with this data, and continue with what it returns.

fields.label: Workflow
fields.help: Its start blocks receive this data. It does not need to be On.

outputs.description: Whatever the called workflow's last block produced.

blocks.label: Set Variable
blocks.description: Add a value to the data flowing through.

blocks.label: Transform
blocks.description: Compute new values with expressions: math, text, lists (sum, sort, pluck…).

fields.label: Values
fields.help: Expressions without {{ }}. See docs/guide for the functions.

blocks.label: Filter
blocks.description: Keep only the list items that match a condition.

fields.label: List
fields.help: Where the list is in the data, e.g. items or data.results (an expression, no {{ }}).

fields.label: Value (per item)
fields.help: Rendered for each item: {{item.…}} is the item, other {{…}} the data.

outputs.description: The kept items, under the list's name or "Save as".

blocks.label: Data Table
blocks.description: Rows of data you paste in (CSV or JSON), e.g. logins to test one by one.

fields.label: Data
fields.help: CSV with a header row (comma, semicolon or tab), or a JSON list.

outputs.description: The rows (or the name you chose).

blocks.label: Save to Dataset
blocks.description: Add rows to a named dataset kept in the browser. See and download it on the Data page.

fields.label: What to save
fields.help: An expression: a list adds one row per item, anything else one row. E.g. items, or item inside a For Each. Build objects with Transform first.

blocks.label: Download
blocks.description: Save a list or a dataset to a CSV or JSON file in Downloads.

fields.label: Value
fields.help: An expression, for "a value from the data".

blocks.label: Notify
blocks.description: Show a desktop notification.

outputs.description: Always true once the notification was shown.

blocks.label: HTTP Request
blocks.description: Call an API or webhook and use the response.

fields.label: Headers
fields.help: One per line, as  Name: value

fields.label: Body
fields.help: Sent for POST, PUT, PATCH and DELETE.

fields.label: Stop the flow on HTTP errors (4xx, 5xx)

outputs.description: The URL that was called (handy as the base for Extract from HTML).
Parsed JSON, when the body is JSON.

blocks.label: Log
blocks.description: Write a line to the run log, e.g. a value you want to see.
